post.title: Stuck on a Problem? Stand Up #shorts
post.description: Where do your best ideas hit you? Tell me in the comments. Send this to someone glued to one screen. Arthur was stuck on one email for an hour. In 'Give Your Ideas Some Legs: The Positive Effect of Walking on Creative Thinking' (Journal of Experimental Psychology: Learning, Memory, and Cognition, 2014), Stanford researchers Marily Oppezzo and Daniel Schwartz tested 176 people, mostly college students. Most came up with more creative ideas while walking than sitting, even on a treadmill facing a blank wall; in one experiment walkers doubled their novel responses, and some of the boost carried over when they sat back down. (On single-right-answer puzzles, walking didn't help.) Stuck? Stand up. #psychology #shorts #creativity #overthinking #walking
